title: CCVS-3ASeg: A Large-Scale Contextual Auxiliary Framework for Road Crack Semantic Segmentation in UAV Imagery
description: Code and supporting materials for CCVS-3ASeg, a task-oriented workflow that links road-region extraction, road-orientation-guided slicing, slice filtering, and adversarial-attention-assisted crack segmentation in UAV imagery.
